svg.title: The same neon design in daylight and under a black light, tan skin. In daylight: neon pink and orange swooshes on the cheeks, a neon green and yellow chevron on the forehead, neon yellow dots down the temples, a blue dot, and ordinary eye-safe purple on the eyelids. Under the black light the room and skin go dark, the neon parts glow brightly, and the ordinary purple near the eyes goes dark, so the glow stays away from the eyes.
